title: Flood & Climate Risk Scoring for Properties

blueprintSignals.name: Elevation above river
blueprintSignals.definition: metres between the lowest floor and the 100-year flood level from LiDAR data
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: LiDAR resolution and age limit precision

blueprintSignals.name: Distance to water
blueprintSignals.definition: distance to the nearest river, coast or drainage channel along the flow path
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Straight-line distance misleads, so use flow paths

blueprintSignals.name: Vegetation fuel
blueprintSignals.definition: fuel load and density within 100 metres from imagery
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Seasonal, so use the dry-season image

blueprintSignals.name: Historic claims density
blueprintSignals.definition: insurance claims per property in the area over 20 years
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Privacy-restricted, and claims depend on take-up

label: For "Flood & Climate Risk Scoring for Properties": Score each property's exposure to flood, wildfire, heat and wind under current and future climate for buyers, lenders and insurers. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Claims come from a few events, so models fit those events and miss others.
